Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the application of chapter 39.12 RCW to construction projects that involve tax incentives, loans, or public land or property that is sold or leased.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the application of chapter 39.12 RCW toconstruction projects that involve tax incentives, loans, or publicland that is sold or leased; and adding a new section to chapter 39.12RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 39.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) This chapter applies to construction projects paid for in wholeor in part by the equivalent of public funds. (2) For purposes of this section, "paid for in whole or in part bythe equivalent of public funds" means: (a) Tax deferrals, exemptions, credits, or any other form of taxincentive established by the state or any county, municipality, orpolitical subdivision created by its laws, and intended to promoteeconomic development; (b) Loans provided to a private entity by the state or any county,municipality, or political subdivision created by its law, or otherassistance provided in connection with the bonding authority of the p. 1 SHB 1992state or any county, municipality, or political subdivision created byits laws that allows a private entity to obtain lower interest ratesfor financing of a construction project; (c) Sales or transfers of public land or property to a privateentity for less than fair market value by the state or any county,municipality, or political subdivision created by its laws; or (d) Longterm leases of public land or property to a private entityfor less than fair market value by the state or any county,municipality, or political subdivision created by its laws. (3)(a) This section does not apply to construction contractsawarded before January 1, 2011. (b) This section applies to construction contracts awarded on orafter January 1, 2011, for all construction projects estimated to costthree million dollars or more and paid for in whole or in part by theequivalent of public funds. (c) This section applies to construction contracts awarded on orafter January 1, 2012, for all construction projects estimated to costtwo million dollars or more and paid for in whole or in part by theequivalent of public funds. (d) This section applies to construction contracts awarded on orafter January 1, 2013, for all construction projects estimated to costone million dollars or more and paid for in whole or in part by theequivalent of public funds. (4) This section only applies to construction projects that wouldnot have been covered by this chapter before the effective date of thissection.
